what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Benin in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3408 Beninese asylum seekers, and Germany hosted 22.0% of them.
After Germany, the largest hosts are Canada, the United States and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Benin with JNIM in every year from 2022 to 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2023 to 2025, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 148 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 3725, at the end of 2024, and was slightly lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
